summary: Stardust Power Inc. filed a 424B5 prospectus supplement amendment (Amendment No. 1) on September 17-18, 2026, updating an at-the-market (ATM) sales agreement with B. Riley Securities dated May 8, 2026. The amendment increases the aggregate offering price eligible for sale under General Instruction I.B.6 to up to $8,990,537, as prior 12-month sales totaled $4,999,985. The stock trades on Nasdaq under SDST at $0.16 as of September 16, 2026, with public float of $13,990,523. This is a routine shelf takedown update, not a special situation.
